tables.id: Clavis择时世俗卷|格言-Hermes Centiloquium
rows: All Diurnal Nativities are strengthned by the Sun, when well beheld by the Fortunes; Nocturnal of the Moon, when she is so fortified. If this happen not, yet if good Planets be found in Angles, the Nativity shall be good.
昼生之命受日之助（吉星吉照）；夜生受月之助（月得固）；若否，吉星居角则命亦佳。

When ♂ Lord of the Ascendant shall be posited in the tenth, it confers on the Native dignity and power; which will be accompanyed with injury and cruelty; and may therefore be said a misfortune rather than happiness.
升主火星落10宫：予尊荣权力，然随之以伤害与残暴——祸而非福。

♃ in good Aspect with the infortunes, changes their malevolency into good. ♀ cannot effect any such thing unless assisted by ♃; therefore in procuring good and prohibiting ill, ♃ is found much better than ♀.
木星吉照凶星使其恶转善；金星无木助则不能——故趋吉避凶木胜于金。

The Artist cannot make a commixion of the Significations of the Stars, before he know their Friendships and Enmities, which is threefold: First, according to their Nature; Secondly, according to their Houses; Thirdly, according to their Aspects.
星之友敌三重：按本性、按宫位、按相位；不知此不能混合诸星之义。
♀ is opposite to ☿. He comprehends Languages and Discipline; she delights and pleasures. ♃ the like to ♂: this coveteth Mercy and Justice; that, Impiety and Cruelty.
金与水相反对：水主语言学问、金主欢愉；木与火相对：木慕慈义、火慕不敬残暴。
Make the ☉ or any of the Superiours to signifie Princes and great Persons, Scribes and Rusticks, the inferiour Planets, and chiefly the ☽.
以日或上位星表王公大人，以下位星（尤月）表小民农夫。
The Signification of the Conjunction is not lessened by an Aspect; but the Aspect is by the Conjunction, as having lesser force than it.
合相之效不因相位而减；相位之效因合相而减（合之力大于相位）。

Give not Judgment, neither Elect any thing, while ♏ is ascending, neither when the Angles are oblique or crooked, or if ♂ be in the Ascendant; the event will prove cross, and the matter come to no good end; for ♏ is a Sign of falsity.
天蝎升时勿下判勿择时；角宫不正或火星在升亦然——天蝎为诈伪之座，事终无善果。
Good Planets afflicted of the Infortunes from the sixth or twelfth Houses, signifie ill.
吉星自6/12宫受凶星所克=凶。
Rumours spread, when the ☽ is in the first face of ♏, are false, and knavishly forged.
月在天蝎首面所传之谣言=伪而诈。

The Judgments of Astrologers are not many times true, by reason of the Error of their instruments, or Querents Ignorance; or when the ☉ is neer the Mid-heaven, or when the Arguments of promise and denyall of the thing are equal in the Figure.
占者之判多失于仪器之误、问者之愚、或日近天顶、或图中断允之证势均力敌。
While the ☽ shall be South descending in ♏ (or ♈), begin then not to build; for a Fabrick then erected quickly comes to ruine.
月南行降于天蝎（或白羊）时勿动工——所建速毁。
☿ being strong and in proper places of the Heavens, well configurated of other Stars in Nativities, denotes convenient dignity to the Native; but ☿ of himself is a Planet weak.
水星强居得宜之位、为诸星吉照=予本命相当之尊；然水星本性自弱。
Whosoever contendeth with another & overcomes when the Significators are in Signes bi-corporeal, gets a great victory; if overcome, looseth much; for then the good or evil is doubled.
征象星居双体座：胜者大胜、败者大败——吉凶翻倍。
Give not judgment before thou knowest the intention of the Querent; for many ask they know not what, nor can they express what they intend.
未知问者之意图勿下判——问者多不知所问。
When thou shalt be interrogated for a Father, behold the fourth House; for a Brother, the third; of a Son, the fifth; of a Wife, the seventh: But if for a sick person, behold the Ascendant only.
问父看4宫、兄弟3、子5、妻7；问病人惟看升点。

When the ☽ shall come to the Quadrate of the Fortunes or Infortunes, and the testimonies of the helps or hinderances of the matter doubtful, it is to be doubted that the strength of the bad Planets will more impede than the others can assist.
月入相吉/凶星之刑而吉凶证两可时，宁信凶星之阻强于吉星之助。

In the beginning of Journeys, and returns therefrom, let not the ☽ be in the Ascendant, fourth, or ninth Houses, although she be not afflicted. In the entring of a City, place her neither in the Ascendant, second, or fourth Houses.
起程与归程之际勿令月落升/4/9宫（虽无克亦然）；入城勿令月落升/2/4宫。

There are three wayes of discovering the Accidents proper to Men: from the Geniture of the Native, Birth of his first Child, or by a Question propounded, with which the mind was solicitous and affected.
人事三途：本命、长子之生、或问者心念之事之问卦。
Every beginning when the ☽ shall be joyned to a Retrograde Planet, will soon be destroyed; and if she shall be otherwise impedited, the mischief will happen the sooner.
月合逆行星而起之事速毁；再受克则祸更速。
Make ♄ and ☉ Significators of Kings and Princes, with the Planet and Planets of the tenth; but their helpers take from the eleventh, and the assistants of vulgar persons from the second House.
以土/日及10宫行星表君相；其助自11宫取、平民之助自2宫。
When a King or Prince sets forth to journey, be sure reject that time when ♋ Ascends.
♊ and ♐ obey the head and tayl of the Dragon more than other Signes; therefore do they work more Mischief in those Signes than they do in any other.
双子宫与人马宫最受龙头龙尾牵制——其为祸尤烈。
When either ♉ or ♎ ascend in Womens Nativities, and ♂ therein, the Native will be immodest and unchaste; the same if ♑ shall Ascend.
女命金牛/天秤升而火在升、或摩羯升=不贞不洁。

The virtues of the Planets are received by the ☉, when he is posited either in the Ascendant or Mid-heaven, in ☌ of them. The ☽ in the night-time receives them also, if in the aforesaid places she be joyned to them.
日居升或天顶合某星则受其德；夜则月于上述之位合星受之。
木解土之毒、金解火之毒。

When a Question is propounded of a Woman, take ♀ as her natural Significatrix, but most particularly the seventh house. But if a Question be asked of an Enemy, respect the twelfth House, but most particularly the seventh also.
问女子取金为本然征象，然最要者第7宫；问敌看12宫，特别亦看7宫。

When any one goeth to War (especially a King), let the Ascendant be one of the Houses of the Superiour Planets, or of the ☉. And let the Lord of the Ascendant, and the ☉ be potent in the Figure; but the Lord of the seventh weak and unfortunate.
出战（尤君王）：令升为上位星或日之宫，升主与日强，7宫主弱而凶。
The ☽ increasing in Light and Motion, and in ☌ of ♄ or ♃ is generally good in all things; but if she be diminished in Light, 'tis ill; understand the contrary when she is in ☌ of ♀ and ♂.
月增光疾行合土/木=诸事吉；月亏=凶；合金火反是（月亏合金火为吉）。

Let not ♃ be under the ☉ beams, or otherwise impedited, when you either pawn or lend things; which if he shall be so, and not received of the Planet impeding, there will be little or no hopes of redemption.
当押物/出借时勿令木焦伤受克——若不获阻星接纳，则物难赎回。

Fortunate Planets going to Conjunction or Aspect of one of the Infortunes, in any Figure, diminishes their evil influence. If the Figure be good, the greater good they do; if ill, the lesser. But the Malevolents in □ or ☌ of the Benevolents diminish and abate of their Virtues.
吉星入相凶星减其恶：图吉则益吉、图凶则减；凶星刑/合吉星损其德。
♄ passing out of one Sign into another, cause strange Apparitions in the Heavens, which the Arabians term Assub, or certain other signs of a Fiery Nature.
土星换座=天现异象（阿拉伯称 Assub）或火性之征。

The ☌ of ♃ and ☉ produceth temperate Air, chiefly when celebrated in aereal signes. From the ☌ of ♄ and ☉ comes cold; and from ☌ of the ☉ & ♂ in the Spring season proceeds a cloudy dark Air, it happening in double bodyed Signes, whence diseases very frequently follow.
木日合主温和之天（风象尤验）；土日合主冷；春日日月火合于双体座=霾天，病随其后。
In Summer, when the ☉ enters the terms of ♄, Heat is caused; in Winter, Drought, and scarcity of Rain and Waters.
夏日入土星之界=热；冬日=旱、缺雨水。

In the Nativities and Questions of Men, make Hyleg, and Alchocoden, and their directions; chiefly in Questions concerning Kings and great Persons, by which accidents are chiefly known, let them be good or evil.
问君王大人之命与卦，务以 Hyleg 与 Alchocoden 及其推运断之。
If the Ascendant be Fortunate, and the Lord thereof Unfortunate, it indicates a sound and healthful body, but an afflicted mind. But if the contrary happen, judge the contrary.
升吉而其主凶=身健而心忧；反之亦然。
Alwayes note the Configurations of the Stars, not by their Signs, but Orbs.
恒按星之容许度（Orb）论其组合，勿只按星座。
Let the ☽ be increasing in Light, and free from the Aspects of the Infortunes, when you would cure sore Eyes.
治目疾令月增光而免凶星之照。
The ⊕ with ill Planets in the fourth, ninth, or tenth houses, denote death to the Sick.
福点与凶星居4/9/10宫=病人死。

When the Significator of either good or evil shall be stationary, and Angular, it shall be more durable. But it shall be the more mutable and variable, if the Significator shall be cadent from Angles, and Retrograde.
吉凶征象星驻而居角=其效持久；降而逆行=多变。
The Lord of the second House hath the same strength in hurting as the Lord of the eighth; the Lord of the eighth, the same with the Lord of the twelfth.
2宫主之害力同8宫主；8宫主之害力同12宫主。
♂ Occidental in ♋ not beheld of ♄ ♃ ♀ or ☉, makes a good Phlebotomist. But if ♂ shall be in ♑, it makes a Destroyer of Men, and one that delights to shed blood.
火星西入巨蟹不为土木金日所照=良放血者；火星在摩羯=杀人者、好流血。
The best Artist in the world may chance to err, when he mistakes a true Significator for a false one.
最精之师亦或误认真征象为伪。
When ♄ shall be elevated above ♀, and in □ of her, it makes the Native shameless, and a perfect Woman-hater. But if ♀ be elevated above ♄, he shall be a great Friend unto Women.
土高于金而刑之=无耻、恨女者；金高于土=女之良友。
If in any nativity ☿ shall be in the Ascendant, Oriental, and swift, the Native will be eloquent, and learned in the Liberal Sciences: the same happeneth if he shall be in ♐ in his proper terms.
水星居升东出疾行=雄辩、通自由学艺；水在人马本界亦然。

The first of the Angles is the Ascendant; the second, the M.C.; the third, the seventh House; the fourth, Immum Coeli. But of the rest of the places, the eleventh is first, then the second; after that, the fifth; then the ninth, and third; but the sixth, eighth, and twelfth are accounted the worst.
♂'s influence is never abated, unless by the interposture of a benevolent Planet.
火之恶除非吉星横亘不减。
Let your Significator agree with his, whom you intend to supplicate.
令征象星与所求之人之征象相合。

The Ascendant, or a Planet found in the last degree, shall the signification must be taken from the following Signe; but if in 29 deg. in the same Signe, the strength of a Planet is considered three wayes, viz. in the degree where he is found, and next preceding and succeeding.
升点或行星居末度=其义移次座；居29度则视前/本/后三度之强。
We should consider of future contingents from the Conjunctions of the Planets, but things past or present from their separations.
未来之事看行星之入相；已过/现在之事看其分离。

When ♃ shall be in ♋ removed from the Ascendant, and no way impedited of any other Star, the Native will be rational, and very expert in Science; but delighting to lead a recluse life, shall not have the due applause of his Learning.
木居巨蟹离升无阻=理性精通科学，然好隐逸不得学名。
In the world many evils will happen, when in one moneth there shall happen an Eclipse of both Luminaries; chiefly in those places subject to the Sign in which they happen.
一月双蚀=举世多难（尤在其所临之座所属之地）。
When the ☽ shall be in the Combust way, or peregrine, in the beginning of a journey, the person will either fall sick in his journey, or shall be otherwise grievously troubled and molested.
月起程时居灼道（♎15°至♏15°）或客居=途中病或大受烦扰。
It behoves the Astrologer to consider the time in Directions of the Planets; but in the fixed Stars it is not so needful.
推运须计行星之时；固定星则不必。
The Fathers Estate shall pass to the Son, if ♄ shall be fortunate, and in friendly Aspect of the Lord of the Ascendant: but this more freely, if ♄ shall be Lord of the fourth.
土吉且吉照升主=父业传子；土为4宫主更验。
Fortunate Planets being in Signs wherein they have no dignity, their benignity is translated another way.
吉星居无尊贵之座=其善转施别途。
♂ Almuten of a Nativity, and not joyned to good planets, signifieth the Native to suffer by envy and hatred.
火为图之主而不合吉星=命主受忌恨之苦。
The fortunate Stars confer great felicity, when they shall be received of each other in their Proper houses; and when the evil Planets are so received, they refrain from doing much mischief.
吉星互居本庙=大福；凶星如此=其恶受制。
The Native will be sickly and weak, when ♄ is elevated above ♂; but if ♂ shall be elevated above ♄, he shall be fat and lusty.
土高于火=命主体弱多病；火高于土=肥壮。
In Men's Nativities, if the part of Marriage shall fall in Signs obedient; and in Women's in Signs imperant, the Woman shall Rule the Man, and the Man shall obey.
男命婚点在顺服座、女命在号令座=女制男；反之男制女。
If the Lords of the Triplicity of the ☌ of the Lights shall friendly respect each other, the first to the second, the second to the third, it shews eminent prosperity, and a freedom from sorrows.
日月合相之三分主互吉照=大繁荣无忧。

☿ in ♓, in deep or pitted degrees, makes the Native foolish and slow of speech; and if ♃ shall be in the Houses of ♂ in pitted degrees, he will be sorded and needy, and receive hurt from Souldiers; but if in the Houses of ♄, chiefly ♑, and in such degrees, he will be morose, rigid, and odious to all men.
水在双鱼深陷度=愚钝迟言；木居火宫陷度=卑污匮乏受军人害；木居土宫（尤摩羯）陷度=乖戾可憎。

☿ in reception of ♂ by Houses, or if he shall be in Aspect of him falling from an Angle, the Native will be a lover of hunting, and to play at Dice and Tables: but if they shall not be cadent, he shall prove an excellent Souldier.
水受火宫位接纳、或自角宫入相火=好猎好赌；若不降则良战士。
Planets under the ☉'s beams, or within twelve degrees thereof, are unfortunate, unless in the same degree with him; but when passed 12 degrees (existentes Orientales) they are fortunate.
星居日之焦灼内（12度内）=凶，除非同度；过12度东出=吉。

The ☊ with the Infortunes denotes terrible mischiefs, for he increases their Malice: but with the Fortunes, he works good, and augments their benignity. But the significations of the Dragons tayl are to be noted the contrary way.
龙头合凶星大增其恶、合吉星增其善；龙尾反是。
☿ in the sixth house of a Nativity, the native shall change from one Religion to another, & will have his Felicity in part impedited by reason of his inconstancy.
水星居本命6宫=命主改宗换教，因不恒而福损。
The first signe hath pre-eminence in signification, when there be two signes have to do with the thing.
两座共涉一事，首座为主。
Accept the beginning of every thing from the Moon, but the end from her dispositor.
事之始取于月、其终取于月之主宰。
If ♃ in the Revolution of the world shall be in his house, exaltation, or oriental in an angle, and otherwise freed from evil, he signifies plenty of all things.
木星在世运图中居本庙/擢升/东出角宫无阻=万物丰足。
When the ☽ and Lord of the Ascendant shall be impedited by the Lord of the 8th, the sick person hath cause to fear.
月与升主受8宫主之克=病人堪忧。
'Tis ill to begin any Law-suits or other Controversies when the ☽ is ill dignified: the Plaintiff without doubt will be overcome.
All Rebellions breaking out at the beginning of the year, are not easily suppressed.
The ☽ in ruminating signes joyn'd to retrograde Planets, it is not then good to purge; the potion will work upward to the Patients injury.
月居反刍座（♈♉♑）合逆行星=勿泻药——药上行反伤。
Oriental Planets signifying either good or evil, perform their work speedily; Occidental, more slowly.
东出之星行其吉凶之事速；西入则缓。
The middle stay of a solar Eclipse is by the degree of the ☌ of the lights.
日蚀之中点=日月合相之度。
There will be many Wars and difficulties happen, when in a Revolutional Figure of the World, ♄ and ♃ shall be in their Exaltations.
世运图中土木各居擢升=多战多难。
Be wary and circumspect in your Judgment, when a Fortune is with a malevolent, nor be you overconfident that the malice of the infortune shall be averted.
吉星伴凶星时慎判，勿信凶恶必被解。
There are twelve Signes, one of which is constantly Ascending: the Ascendant signifies the body, and the Lord thereof the mind. Let not that Signe Ascend for your purpose, whose Lord is impedited.
十二座恒有一升：升表其身、其主表其心；勿令其主受克之座升以谋事。
Planets in fixed Signs shew the matter durable; in bi-corporeal Signes, doubtful; in moveable, convertible to good or evil.
星居定座=事持久、双体座=可疑、动座=可善可恶。
In matters of secrecy, let not the ☽ be combust, but going from combustion.
机密之事勿令月焦伤，令其离焦伤。
When the ☽ is in a fixed Sign, neither cut out, or put on any new Garments, chiefly in ♌, why 'tis extream dangerous: 'tis the same if she be in ☌ or ☍ of the ☉, or impedited of the Infortunes.
月居定座勿裁衣（尤狮子座，极险）；月合冲日或受凶星亦然。
The ☽ hath great power in all Questions, except when ♌ ♑ or ♒ Ascend: for either of those Signes abate of her Significations; chiefly ♌ or ♒.
月于一切问卦有大权，除非狮子/摩羯/水瓶升（尤狮子水瓶减其力）。
♄ is under the Sun-beams until he be 15 degrees distant from him. Understand the same of ♃.
Refuse the ☽ in ♋ or ♍ for Marriages, unless it be in marrying of Widdows.
婚配勿取月居巨蟹/室女（娶寡妇可）。
An Infortune in his own House or Exaltation, and Oriental, is better than a Fortune Retrograde, or impedited.
凶星居本庙/擢升东出=优于吉星逆行或受克。

Immense prosperity is portended, when the Lord of the Triplicity of the Luminaries shall have virtue in an angle or succedent House, and be in their proper places, remote from the Aspects of the Infortunes; and if the Lord of the Ascendant shall be well seated also, the happiness shall be the more and the greater.
日月三分主居角/续宫得宜、远凶星、升主亦佳=大福。
The Aspects of the ∗ or △ have the same quality: but the ∗ is less forcible than the △, either in good or evil.
六合三合之质一也；然六合之力逊于三合（吉凶皆然）。
♄ performs evil slowly, but ♂ swift; and therefore ♂ is reputed to hurt more than ♄.
土行恶缓、火行恶速——故火之害较土为烈。
When the three superiour Planets shall be conjoyned in Regal Signes, it is termed a great Conjunction, and when the ☉ beholds them, they make most Potent and Flourishing Kingdoms.
三上位星会于王座（♌♉♐?）=大合相；日又照之=王国强盛。
Those doubts are soon resolved, that are propounded when the ☽ and the Planet to whom she applies are in Signes having voice, and in the first or third Houses, or in opposition of them.
月与入相之星居有声之座（♈♉♊♌♍♎♐♑♒?）、在1/3宫或其冲=所问速决。
The Infortunes in the eighth house have their malice increased; but the Benevolents being there, portend neither good nor evil.
凶星居8宫恶增；吉星居8宫无吉无凶。
There will neither good or evil be performed, but when the good or bad Planets in a Nativity or Revolution shall aspect the ☽ by a Quadrate.
吉凶之星不刑照月，则吉凶皆不显。
If ☿ be afflicted in the sixth house, the Native shall die in prison: if ♄ shall be in the twelfth, and ♀ in the eighth, he shall end his dayes by precipitation.
水星受克居6宫=死于狱；土在12、金在8=坠亡。
When the ☉ in the day-time, and the ☽ in the night, in the beginning of any Sickness, is impedited, the person is to be feared.
病初日（昼）受克、夜月受克=其人堪忧。
The Significations of the Stars are alwayes varyed, as they vary in their Configurations and Latitudes.
星之含义随其配置与纬度而变。

The ☽ in the fourth, seventh, ninth or twelfth Houses shews the true cause of the Question propounded; the same is known by her separation from ☿. And if the Ascendant and ☽ shall be in double-bodyed Signes, the cause of the question is confirmed.
月在4/7/9/12宫=问卦之真因；观其自水星之分离亦知；升与月居双体座=事因确。

An Infortune in his House or Exaltation denotes the matter by him signified to come to a good end, but with delayes: but if he shall be impedited in the Ascendant though in his house or Exaltation, the matter will be obstructed, and come to an ill end.
凶星居本庙/擢升=所主之事成而缓；居升虽在庙耀受克=事阻且终凶。

The event of every Enterprize that is doubtful, is terminated by these Significators: the fourth House and his Lord, and the Planet strong in the same; also by the light of the time and the Lord thereof; and by the Planet and his Dispositer to whom the said Light of the Time is Conjoyned.
疑事之结局观：4宫及其主、宫内强星；时之光（昼夜日/月）及其主；时之光所合之星与其主宰。
(The End of Hermes his 100 Aphorismes; Coley 版编号至 99。)
（Hermes 格言集终；Coley 本编号1-99，题称100。）

tables.id: Clavis择时世俗卷|格言-Bethem Centiloquium
rows: Thou mayest know, when a Planet is Retrograde, he is as a man infirm, stupified, and solicitous.
行星逆行=如病弱、昏聩、忧虑之人。
If Cadent, he is as a man dead, and hath no motion.
行星降宫=如已死之人、无运动之力。
If Combust, as a man in Prison, without hope of Liberty.
行星焦伤=如狱中之人、无获释之望。
If Stationary to Retrogradation, as a healthful man receding from health; yet there is hope of Recovery remaining.
将逆而驻=如康人渐衰，然尚有康复之望。
If Stationary to Direction, as a sick man amending.
If Besieged, as a man fearful, between two Enemies: (i.e.) when between the two Infortunes.
行星被围（夹于两凶星间）=如畏惧之人陷于两敌之间。
A Planet between ♃ and ♀, is as a man pleasant and free from Want and Trouble.
行星夹于木金之间=如欢悦、无匮乏之忧之人。
If Aspected of the Infortunes from the fourth House, as a Man on whom Death is approaching.
行星自4宫受凶星所照=如死期将至之人。
Planet in Aspect of his Enemy, as a man fearing to be Trapann'd or Betrayed.
行星入相其敌=如惧遭陷卖之人。
A Planet in Conjunction of an Infortune, is as one fighting with his Enemy.
行星合凶星=如与敌搏斗之人。
A Planet in Conjunction of a Fortune, is as one in his Friends Embraces.
行星合吉星=如投入友人之怀。
A Planet in anothers house who rules the same Trigon, is as a man in the house of his friend.
行星居他星之庙而同主一三分=如居友人之家。
Cadent from house or Exaltation, he is as one absent from his abode.
行星离其庙/擢升而降=如离家之人。
A Planet in his House or Exaltation, is as one in his Castle or Strong-hold.
行星居本庙/擢升=如据城自守之人。
If there Retrograde, he is as a sick man at home.
在庙而逆行=如家居之病者。
If combust in his own House, he is as a man confined thereto by his King.
居本庙而焦伤=如被王幽禁于宅之人。
If in his own Dignity and Cadent, as a man vexed and fearful.
居本然尊贵而落降宫=如忧惧不安之人。
Fortunate Planets Retrograde, are unfortunate: if Cadent from Angles, or their houses, &c. as one hoping for good but misses it.
吉星逆行=为凶；自角宫或其庙而降=如盼善而不得之人。
A Fortune Retrograde with an infortune, strengthens the Infortunes nature, but abates the worth of his own.
吉星逆行伴凶星：增凶之恶、减己之德。
An Infortune in his own house Direct, & there joyned to a Fortune, his malignancy shall turn to good.
凶星居本庙顺行而合吉星=其恶转善。
A Planet in the last degree of a Sign, is as one falling from his Estate.
行星居座之末度=如失势倾覆之人。
A Planet in the first degrees of a Signe, he is weak in Signification.
行星居座之初度=其义弱。
From the first degree to the fifteenth, a Planet is rising; but from the 15th to the 25th, he is compleat in strength.
A Planet in the last five degrees of a Sign, is as a man leaving his House.
行星居座末五度=如离家之人。
An Earthy Planet in the Ascendant strong, argues good in any thing (i.e. A Planet ruling the Earthy Triplicity).
土性星（主土象三分之星）强居升点=诸事吉。
A Planet not in his own house, as a man knocking at anothers door; and his signification is to be slighted, he having no power in that place.
行星不居本庙=如叩他人之门，其义当轻——彼于此位无权。
When Planets are with the Sun, their significations and power are abated & much lessened thereby.
行星与日同在=其义与力大减。
When Planets are in the last degrees of a Signe Retrograde, their Judgments are transmitted, their Light lessened, and their Strength and Glory abated.
行星居座末度而逆行=其判移转、其光减、其力荣损。
A Planet seven degrees distant from the Sun in his own House, Retrograde, is as a man in his Castle in the power of his Enemy, striving to abandon Slavery.
行星居本庙距日7度而逆行=如在己堡中受敌制、奋力脱奴役之人。
A Planet in the house of his Enemy, is as a man in such a Condition, viz. a real Prisoner.
行星居敌之宫=如真囚徒。
A Planet in his own House, free from affliction, declares the perfection of the Question, or thing interrogated.
行星居本庙免克=所问之事成全。
The Moon separating from a Planet, shews what is past.
月自某星分离=示已过之事。
But applying to one, denotes what is to come.
月入相某星=示将来之事。
If she be separating from ♄ in any Question, she shews Sorrow, Discord, Trouble.
If from ♃, Mirth, Pleasure, Wealth, and good Fortune.
If from ♂, Contention, Strife, Bloodshed, Bonds, False-witness.
月离火=争、斗、流血、系缚、伪证。
If from the ☉, she signifies Sicknesses, Cares, Fears, Imprisonments.
If from ♀, then Judge Lust, Sport, Laughter, Dancing, Singing.
月离金=纵欲、嬉戏、笑、舞、歌。
From ☿, judge according as ☿ is posited.
月离水=按水星之位判之。
The Moon applying to a Planet, shews things to come, according as her application is with them.
月入相某星=按其所入相之星示将来。
The Moon Fortunate in the morning, the Querents business prospers the better all the day long. One born then will be fortunate.
晨月吉=问者终日事顺；彼时生者运吉。
But if she be Unfortunate in the morning, it shews Corruption in the Question; he that is born then dies quickly, or will be sickly.
晨月凶=问卦有损；彼时生者速死或多病。
The Moon in Conjunction of ♄, usually proves an ill day for every work.
月合土=诸事皆不利之日。
The Moon in Conjunction of ♃, is observed to be a good day for all things in general.
The Moon in Conjunction of ♂, is unfortunate for every purpose, as has been experienced.
月合火=诸事皆凶（经验所证）。
The Moon in Conjunction of the ☉, is fit for private business. He that then falls sick, dyes.
月合日=宜私事；彼时病者死。
The Moon in Conjunction of ♀, 'tis a good day, chiefly in Love matters.
The Moon in Conjunction of ☿, 'tis a good day, chiefly for Contracts and Writings.
月合水=吉日，尤宜契约文书。
The Moon in Opposition of ♄, a bad day in all things, especially to Saturnine people.
月冲土=诸事皆凶，尤不利土性之人。
The Moon in ☍ of ♃, laudable in all things (Vix Credo), for Oppositions rarely produce good effects.
月冲木=诸事可称（Coley 自注：吾不敢信——冲相罕生善果）。
The Moon in Opposition of ♂, begin nothing of weight that day, for no good end can be expected.
月冲火=是日勿举大事——难期善果。
The Moon in Opposition of the ☉, good in no manner of work or business, therefore to be avoided.
月冲日=诸事无利，当避之。
The ☽ in ☍ of ♀, a laudable day in all things (Vix Credo). The contrary often happens, especially to women.
月冲金=诸事可称（Coley 不敢信）——反者常验，尤于女子。
The Moon in ☍ of ☿, a good day for every work. Not for Contracts I'm sure. Let them be excepted.
月冲水=诸事吉日；然契约除外（Coley 断言）。
The Moon in □ of ♄, is a bad day. Chiefly in meeting with Kings and great persons. Let not Noble and Eminent Men then take Journeys. The sick man will hardly escape that is taken sick at such a time.
月刑土=凶日，尤忌谒君贵人；贵人勿出行；彼时病者难逃。
The Moon in □ of ♃, is a good day in access to great men, to attain Friends, but in △ to ♃ is much better.
月刑木=宜谒贵人、结友；然三合木更佳。
The Moon in Quartile of ♂, is unfortunate in all things; chiefly in contending with great men; in Marriage; the sick man dyes, or bleeds, that then falls sick.
月刑火=诸事皆凶，尤忌与贵人争、婚娶；彼时病者亡或失血。
The Moon in Quartile of the ☉, is good to manage the affairs of great Persons; but the Trine Aspect must be preferred before it.
月刑日=宜理贵人事务；然三合日更胜。
The Moon in Quartile of ♀, is good in all things, chiefly in Love matters. These Aphorisms must be warily understood.
月刑金=诸事吉，尤宜情爱（此等格言当慎解）。
The Moon in □ of ☿, is a good day to Merchandise, study, or Converse with Kings.
月刑水=宜商贾、学问、谒君。
The Moon in ∗ of ♄, is good to converse with Ancient People, or to begin any work of a Saturnine Nature.
月六合土=宜与长者交谈、起土性之事。
